verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README says vLLM can be built from source for development, so the core 'build from source' capability is documented. Nothing in the pack shows the build has minimal external dependencies; the install guidance actually centers on a PyTorch backend (--torch-backend). Missing for 10: any documented source-build procedure or steps, evidence of a minimal or lightweight dependency footprint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building from source.
